method: Genetic full-match training initialized from Extreme, followed by contextual control safeguards. Final selection targets human-style attacks; no claim of universal bot dominance.
limitations: Human-style opponents are deterministic synthetic policies, not human participants.
This release trades weaker bot head-to-head results for stronger results against the tested human-style attacks.
Original shot dispersion and physics remain; perfect shooting or unbeatable play is not promised.
Open-shot makes are possession outcomes and may include recoveries; the three-point count is reported separately.
Defense drill results are diagnostic, not proof of superior defense on every attack.

protocol.primary: Independent scripted human styles: quick jumper, pump fake, retreating three, drive. These are synthetic opponents, not real human participants.
protocol.extremeHeadToHead: Reported as a matchup tradeoff, not a promotion gate. The selected candidate lost that development comparison. The release targets human-style attacks, not universal bot dominance.
